STATUS: ANSWER
Use build_docker_remote.sh, which creates the full GATK4 image using Google Cloud Build remotely [gatk_docker#h001]. First set your project with gcloud config set project <PROJECT>, choosing a project that has access to Cloud Build [gatk_docker#h001]. Example: export GITHUB_TAG=4.2.6.1, then sudo bash build_docker_remote.sh -e ${GITHUB_TAG} -d ${STAGING_DIR} [gatk_docker#h004]. The image is tagged as us.gcr.io/broad-dsde-methods/broad-gatk-snapshots/gatk-remote-builds:<USERNAME>-<GITHUB_TAG>-<GIT_HASH> [gatk_docker#h001].
